messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "treatment for at least 5 days in children"
set: ["treatment for at least 5 days in children", "anxiety in adults and children at least 7 years old", "asthma attacks in adults and children at least 2 years old", "PE in children", "DVT in children", "treatment for blood clots", "slowed growth in children", "adults and children at least 2 years old with symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis", "clots happening again in children", "major depressive disorder in adults and adolescents at least 12 years old", "complete program of treatment for hypertension", "treating high blood pressure in children", "overweight adults with at least one weight-related medical condition", "close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain", "around-the-clock treatment of pain for extended period", "Treatment-resistant depression for adults who have not responded to at least two adequate antidepressant trials"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
